subject: Launch Week Promo Allocation Request - Murmur Labs
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@murmurlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Launch Week Promo: Redwood credits for Murmur Labs

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well — we’re two weeks out from Murmur Labs’ public launch (June 30) and we’re expecting a big spike in inference usage for our recommendation flows. We’d like to request a short-term promotional credit + temporary trial extension so we can avoid throttling during the first 10 days of live traffic while we finalize autoscaling.

What we’re asking for:
- Promotional credit equivalent to ~$5k in usage (tokens + embeddings) for launch week (June 30 -- July 9)
- 30-day trial extension on our current sandbox to cover post-launch testing
- Agreement on two delivery milestones: signal threshold report (day 5) and cost reconciliation (day 14)

Attached is a short usage forecast and spikes estimate (murmurlabs-usage-forecast.csv). We can also share a short mutual action plan if that helps speed approval.

Security/compliance: we are SOC2-in-progress but can provide our SOC2 questionnaire answers and IP whitelist for the trial.

Can you let me know if this is possible and what approvals you’ll need? We’re happy to sign a short promo agreement.

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Co-founder, Murmur Labs
sara@murmurlabs.com
(Attachment: murmurlabs-usage-forecast.csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@murmurlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch Week Promo: Redwood credits for Murmur Labs

Hi Sara — appreciate the heads-up and congrats on the upcoming launch.

Short answer: we can generally support a short-term promo + trial extension, but I need a quick approval from Partner Ops and our Program team and I’ll route a simple promo agreement. I’ve looped Laura (Partner Ops) and Priyom (Programs) — Laura can confirm budgeting and compliance runway, Priyom can handle the promo terms and milestone language.

Proposed path:
- Redwood provides $5k equivalent credit, applied to usage during Jun 30–Jul 9
- Extend trial sandbox by 30 days from current expiry date
- Milestones: Murmur to submit signal snapshot on Jul 5; joint cost reconciliation doc due Jul 14
- Promo terms to include data handling commitments and a short indemnity clause (standard)

Laura/Priyom — can you review the budget and quick legal/ops ask? I attached an outline promo terms doc for review (promo-terms-draft.pdf). If we’re good, I’ll send a signed DocuSign and enable the credits on the account.

Sara — once we have approval we’ll send the agreement and a quick runbook for prefix caching that may reduce peak cost by ~20%.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
(Attachment: promo-terms-draft.pdf)

Subject: Fwd: Launch Week Promo: Redwood credits for Murmur Labs

Laura / Priyom — forwarding Sara’s note and our proposed terms. Key asks: $5k promo, 30-day trial extension, two milestones (signal snapshot + reconciliation).

Notes for review:
- Account: Murmur Labs (small B2B recommendation startup)
- Urgency: credits must be enabled before Jun 30 to avoid throttling during first 48 hours
- Risk: they are SOC2-in-progress; they can provide questionnaire answers. Recommend requiring the questionnaire and an IP whitelist before enabling credits.
- Finance: I have some flexibility in the deal desk for promotional credits under $6k; confirm if legal needs any extra clause beyond standard promo terms.

I attached the draft terms again. If you both sign off, I’ll: 1) trigger finance to reserve the promo line, 2) send DocuSign link to Sara, and 3) place a temporary tag and usage alert on the account to watch spend.
